cases.finding: Q2/2Q, escaped newlines, global scale inline versus separate row are equivalent.
Source reads WACO E/G; derived annotation corrects WACOE/G. Original human store unchanged.
Explicit source footnotes are annotations; repeated headers start three subtables.
Source superscripts restored as explicit annotations, not bare appended digits.
Four 2024 values appear in a column without the 2024 header; native value probabilities remain very high.
Inline italic tags in public labels must not cause period headers to become data.
Grouped year spans and several numeric values are wrong; equivalent (11%) / (11)% notation is normalized.
June 30 becomes June 31; 470,009 becomes 470,099; 409,507 becomes 490,507. GriTS partial credit hides impact.

limitations: Rule-based financial fact interpretation is not a universal table parser.
Strict row/header transcription can penalize harmless wording changes; GriTS is a complementary view.
Footnote content itself is outside financial-fact matching.
Global scale captions are retained, but full dimensional/unit reasoning is not implemented.
Benchmarks can overlap model pretraining; these labels are not independent human checks.
